purpose: Manual evaluation checklist only; never include in model input or generate runtime findings from this file.
source_identifiers: Clause markers below are not source_id values. Resolve actual source IDs from the current parsed documents.

cases.check: The same company-wide monthly risk report moves from Head of Analytics to Risk Coordinator. Preserve parent role context and both sources.
must_not: Claim the reporting duty was lost
Infer a department was abolished from a position heading

cases.check: Annual completeness review of the risk register changes from mandatory to discretionary. Match meaning despite renumbering.
must_not: Classify as a completely absent duty
Match clauses solely by their number

cases.check: Search the entire provided After set for quarterly archiving of the access-policy exception log, record the search and state that no counterpart was found in the provided set.
must_not: Claim the real company no longer archives data
Treat incomplete search as proof of loss

cases.check: Two different roles hold exclusive final approval for the same northern-branch supplier list. Both After sources and role headings support the issue.
must_not: Ignore owner context because the clause bodies are identical

cases.check: The procurement role both concludes and audits the same northern-branch contracts; the prior independent review provides context. Request human review.
must_not: Invent a legal prohibition or external standard
State that an actual violation or misconduct is proven

cases.check: Training reports cover different branches, so matching actions do not create duplicate responsibility.
must_not: Label distinct northern and southern scopes as a conflict or duplicate

cases.check: ДНМ and ДККМ remain listed; ДИТААД and ДОА are newly listed. Actual creation dates are unknown.

Work with results of other internal-control actors and insufficient/duplicate risk coverage transfers from the director of ДНМ to heads of ДИТААД/ДОА, retaining scope specialisation. Function is not lost.
Осуществляется анализ becomes может осуществляться анализ: weakened obligation, not disappearance.
Renumbering of rights alone does not establish loss.
Quarterly/annual reporting remains in the After document; do not infer its disappearance from a changed ДККМ subclause.
Specific named powers may lack an explicit counterpart, but quality control itself remains. Report a question after searching, not complete loss of the function.
References resolve to existing numbers but may now point to prohibitions instead of former rights; do not claim a missing target solely because its meaning changed.
Split joined numbered clauses with exact offsets; leave empty 5.5.3 empty; flag absent Appendix 1, preserve parent role context and never invent page numbers or an attachment.

must_not: Invent a new conflict of interest in the real pair merely to demonstrate the feature
Treat a position heading as proof of an abolished department
Claim complete organisational coverage from two revisions of a single audit policy
Send this checklist to the model as the expected answer
